a: Store currency as integer minor units (kobo/cents) to avoid float errors.
If using decimals, use exact decimal types — never binary floats.
Record the rate and time used for conversions.
Define rounding rules (bankers vs half-up) explicitly.
Allocate remainders deterministically when splitting amounts.
Double-entry ledgers keep debits and credits balanced.
Format with locale separators and correct symbol placement.
Be explicit whether prices include tax.
